descriptions.value: The Subscribe to Comments WordPress plugin before 2.3.3 does not sign or validate a cookie it trusts to identify a commenter, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose a subscriber's management key and silently alter that subscriber's subscriptions.

assertions.title: Subscribe to Comments < 2.3.3 - Unauthenticated Subscription Management Key Disclosure via Forged Comment Cookie

descriptions.description: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Subscribe to Comments < 2.3.3 - Unauthenticated Subscription Management Key Disclosure via Forged Comment Cookie
